title: Verify C_SignInit returns CKR_OPERATION_ACTIVE before mechanism check
description: test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c was updated so test_init_error_path_active_flag and test_sign_init_active_cleared_on_error now expect CKR_OPERATION_ACTIVE on double-SignInit (correct per PKCS#11 2.40 spec sec.5.3.2), and CKR_OK on the following C_Sign. The old tests expected CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID then CKR_OPERATION_NOT_INITIALIZED. Verify that the C_SignInit implementation in src/wp11_pkcs11.c actually checks sign_active BEFORE it validates the mechanism argument. If the implementation still validates mechanism first and returns CKR_MECHANISM_INVALID, the tests are wrong (they pass because they match wrong behavior) and a real PKCS#11 client will fail with spec-compliant double-init handling.
